thread.title: Apple Stock Downgraded On 'Lukewarm' iPhone Sales; Shares Rise

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Stock Downgraded On 'Lukewarm' iPhone Sales; Shares Rise
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) shares fell Wednesday after a Wall Street analyst said the company is having a "good, not great iPhone cycle."
Longbow Research analyst Shawn Harrison lowered his rating on Apple stock to neutral from buy. He also cut his fiscal 2018 iPhone shipment forecast to 233 million units, from 248 million. Current consensus is for 240 million iPhone units shipped this year, he said.
Harrison also trimmed his full-year target for earnings per share to $11.25 from $11.54. Wall Street's consensus for Apple earnings per share in fiscal 2018 is $11.47.
Apple shares gained 1.7% to close at 179.10 on the stock market today . On Tuesday, Apple stock hit a record high of 179.39, before reversing and ending the day down 0.5% to 176.19.
Consumer reception to the premium-priced iPhone X and the midrange iPhone 8 series handsets has been "lukewarm," Harrison said in a note to clients.
"Our checks now point to mid- to high single-digit fiscal 2018 iPhone shipment growth vs. consensus of 11% growth," he said.
"A tempered iPhone growth outlook should limit stock price appreciation," Harrison said. But the stock should remain above valuation lows thanks to Apple's expanded business base, including services, and the potential for repatriating foreign cash, he said.
